newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares slip, pulled down by Probanka.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares slip, pulled down by Probanka.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.17 percent on Monday, pulled down by bank Probanka as it fell prey to a technical correction.

Traders expect the market to show little movement with trading volume remaining at a low ebb until parliament votes on whether to ratify the association agreement with the European Union, which is expected to happen next week.
* The SBI index fell 2.3 points to 1,321.03.
* Probanka shed 3.37 percent after gaining 3.9 percent last week. It closed at 20,100 tolars on volume of 1,000 shares.
Traders said Probanka may have bottomed out as its price seemed low compared to its business results and prospects. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
